title: Monastery of Saint George of Choziba

groundCutout.basis: A narrow opening at the mapped footbridge exposes its stone arches above the Wadi Qelt channel. The sloped channel mesh meets the original terrain at all four edges.

buildingCutout.basis: The measured 1883 ground outline defines the historic monastery core on the cliff ledge.

terrainReference.basis: Native Copernicus datum sampled along the south face of the mapped cliff ledge.

names: Monastery of Saint George of Choziba
mapIdentity.scope: The OSM monastery node and mapped approach anchor the historic core. The 1883 measured plan fixes shape and foundation scale where the monastery replaced earlier buildings. The rebuilt walls and arch profiles are interpreted from period images.

note: The two post-rebuilding illustrations and the Patriarchate confirm the ordered levels, domes and cliffside construction. Model heights follow image proportions relative to the measured plan.
